svg.title: Two threads holding seat B2 without and with a lock
svg.desc: Left: without a lock, thread 1 checks B2 is free, thread 2 checks B2 is free, thread 1 writes its hold, thread 2 overwrites it with its own; both users are told they hold B2. Right: with the show lock, thread 2 waits until thread 1 has checked and written, then sees B2 held and is refused.
svg.text: alice (T1) and bob (T2) both want B2; time runs down
